tweaks.name: Install NVIDIA Profile Inspector
tweaks.description: Installs NVIDIA Profile Inspector through WinGet for automated driver-profile imports.
tweaks.impact: Adds an advanced NVIDIA driver profile editor used by Optimal's named profiles.
tweaks.tradeoff: The tool exposes hidden and driver-specific values; use only Optimal's reviewed profiles unless you understand NVAPI settings.

tweaks.name: NVIDIA Balanced Latency profile
tweaks.description: Backs up custom NVIDIA profiles, then enables Low Latency Mode and highest available refresh rate globally.
tweaks.impact: Reduces the render queue without forcing maximum GPU power at all times.
tweaks.tradeoff: Global driver overrides can conflict with application-managed settings. NVIDIA Profile Inspector must be installed first.

tweaks.name: NVIDIA Competitive profile
tweaks.description: Backs up custom profiles, then applies Ultra Low Latency, maximum-performance power mode, highest refresh, threaded optimization, and high-performance texture filtering globally.
tweaks.impact: Prioritizes responsiveness and consistent clocks for competitive gaming.
tweaks.tradeoff: Raises idle power, heat, and fan noise and can reduce image quality. Some DX12 games ignore driver low-latency mode in favor of NVIDIA Reflex.
